# Keep the Light 1.27.0

- **A "Which one?" window for TMDB.** When the queue's TMDB lookup finds several shows or films with the same name, a small window now asks once per title, for example "Which *The Office*? 22 files". It shows the top 3 matches with posters, and you can type a year and search again. Pick the right one and every waiting file with that title is filled in, each episode with its own details. The choice is remembered for next time. Rows that still need a match have a **Choose…** button.
- **Crop black bars (576p and 480p only).** A new tick box under Resolution appears when you choose one of the two standard-definition sizes. Black bars around the picture, such as a 4:3 show stored in a widescreen frame, are found and cut, then the picture is shrunk to fit. It never cuts into the picture itself, and Dolby Vision files are left alone.
